title: RADIUS Accounting

provenance.original_holder: IETF RADIUS working group / Livingston participation

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 2866 defines accounting information exchange between a Network Access Server client and a shared RADIUS accounting server.
RADIUS Accounting records session/service events including start, stop, interim updates and session/link information.
claims_extracted.notes: Supports treating accounting as a sibling protocol branch to authentication/authorization.

claims_extracted.claim: Early RADIUS Accounting deployment used UDP port 1646 before the officially assigned 1813 port.
claims_extracted.notes: The corresponding authentication-port 1645→1812 history requires separate source extraction.

notes: Primary source for reconstructing access-server session accounting and the accounting-specification branch (2059→2139→2866).
